content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Required Sessions ## slug: required-sessions ## seoTitle: Required Sessions ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ## Prerequisites **Events app:** The Required Sessions feature is available for {{variable.Product_Events}} versions 5.4 and higher. **Capacity:** Event Organizers must manually ensure that the configuration of {{variable.Object_Event}}/{{variable.Object_EventItem}}/{{variable.Object_Session}} capacity includes the mandatory {{variable.Object_Session}}. For example, if 70 Tickets require a specific {{variable.Object_Session}}, but only 60 spots are available for the {{variable.Object_Session}}’s capacity, there will be an issue. **Event Items:** Product and Donation {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s cannot be associated with a {{variable.Object_Session}}, either as a mandatory or regular one. ## About the Required Sessions Feature The Required Sessions feature allows Event Organizers to mark specific {{variable.Object_Session}}s as mandatory. Now, if a {{variable.Object_Session}}’s related {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} is designated as a requirement, and an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} adds the related Ticket ({{variable.Object_EventItem}}) to their cart, the {{variable.Object_Session}} will be automatically added to the cart and registration. The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} cannot remove the requisite {{variable.Object_Session}} from their cart and leave the Ticket. The {{variable.Object_Session}} will only be removed if the associated Ticket is removed. The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} also cannot unregister for the {{variable.Object_Session}} without unregistering for the related Ticket. ## Benefits ### Event Organizers * They have greater control over agenda-building. * They can tailor the {{variable.Object_Session}} selection step while eliminating the need to create separate flows that automatically add {{variable.Object_Session}}s. * They no longer need to manually add a missed {{variable.Object_Session}} after an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers for the {{variable.Object_Event}}, reducing post-registration follow-up. * When running multi-session {{variable.Object_Event}}s, they can ensure {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s register for high-priority or compliance-related {{variable.Object_Session}}s. (e.g., universities, training programs, onboarding events) ### Attendees * {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s enjoy a streamlined and simplified registration experience. * Designating a {{variable.Object_Session}} as compulsory removes extra clicks for {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s by automatically adding necessary {{variable.Object_Session}}s. * {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s are presented with clear expectations during registration, reducing friction and ensuring they do not miss registering for critical {{variable.Object_Session}}s. ## Use Case University ABC is hosting an open house for newly enrolled students and their parents. The {{variable.Object_Event}} offers two types of Tickets - one for students and one for parents. * Ticket 1: Student ({{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Main event item”) * Ticket 2: Parent (({{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Guest”) Ticket 1 and Ticket 2 each include mandatory and optional {{variable.Object_Session}}s. | Ticket Type | Mandatory Sessions | Optional Sessions | | --- | --- | --- | | Ticket 1: Student | | | | | Welcome Pep Rally | Financial Aid | | | Lunch | Athletic Facility Tour | | | | Meet with Academic Advisor | | | | Dorm Tour | | Ticket 2: Parent | | | | | President’s Briefing | Financial Aid | | | Lunch | Athletic Facility Tour | | | | Meet with Academic Advisor | | | | Faculty Panel | For this multi-session {{variable.Object_Event}}, students will be automatically registered for the mandatory {{variable.Object_Session}}s, “Welcome Pep Rally” and “Lunch.” Parents will be registered for the mandatory {{variable.Object_Session}}s, “President’s Briefing” and “Lunch.” Both parents and students can also select and register for any of the optional {{variable.Object_Session}}s related to their Ticket type. While this use case is for a university’s open house, you can use the Required Sessions feature for any multi-session event. ## How it Works ### Configure a Required Session You can mark {{variable.Object_Session}}s as mandatory in two locations. * **{{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} Record:** The {{variable.Field_EVItemSession_Required}} (conference360__Required__c) field is located on the related {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} record. Its default setting is “False” or unchecked. * **Event Builder:** The {{variable.Field_EVItemSession_Required}} field is located in the Event Item section of the Event Builder in the step where you relate the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} to {{variable.Object_Session}}s and is unchecked by default. If an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} has a related {{variable.Object_Session}} and the {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}’s {{variable.Field_EVItemSession_Required}} field is set to “True” (checked), the {{variable.Object_Session}} will automatically be added to an {{variable.Object_Attendee}}’s cart when they add the related {{variable.Object_EventItem}}. Note: The field permissions for the {{variable.Field_EVItemSession_Required}} field are the same as the object permissions of the {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} object. ### Register for a Session An {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can register for a mandatory {{variable.Object_Session}} or be registered by an Event Organizer in one of three locations. #### From the Events Webapp * Non-elective {{variable.Object_Session}}s are enforced when registering via the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s webpage ({{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}}). * The Required Sessions registration flow manages capacity on the webapp side only. * If the capacities of the Event Items and Sessions are not manually configured to include mandatory Sessions, the following issue may occur. Tickets connected to sold-out mandatory Sessions are marked as “Sold out” on the Event website, even if the Ticket has available capacity in Salesforce. #### From the AttendeeLink * Non-elective {{variable.Object_Session}}s are enforced for AttendeeLink {{variable.Object_Session}} registrations. An {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can’t unregister using their AttendeeLink after registering if the {{variable.Object_Session}} is marked as required. * {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s can register for a mandatory {{variable.Object_Session}} from their AttendeeLink if an Event Organizer sets the {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}’s {{variable.Field_EVItemSession_Required}} status after the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} has completed the {{variable.Object_Event}} registration process. However, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} cannot unregister for that {{variable.Object_Session}} from their AttendeeLink. #### From Salesforce * The mandatory {{variable.Object_Session}}/{{variable.Object_EventItem}} relationship is not enforced when adding {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s from Salesforce. To maintain the relationship, Event Organizers must manually register an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} for both the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} and the mandatory {{variable.Object_Session}}. * Event Organizers must also manage the capacity for both {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s and mandatory {{variable.Object_Session}}s to ensure availability when registering {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s in Salesforce. ### Updated Attendee Flow During registration, the {{variable.Product_Events}} app automatically adds a non-elective {{variable.Object_Session}} to an {{variable.Object_Attendee}}’s cart when the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} adds the related Ticket. The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will see the “Added” text in the selector button to indicate the {{variable.Object_Session}} was added to the cart. The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} cannot remove that {{variable.Object_Session}} from their cart. However, if they remove the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} from the cart, the non-elective {{variable.Object_Session}} will also be removed. If a {{variable.Object_Session}} is required but is sold out, the associated {{variable.Object_EventItem}} will also be marked as sold out. ## Required Sessions vs. Min/Max Sessions and Event Items :::(Info) (Min/Max Sessions and Event Items Feature) Although this section talks about the Min/Max Sessions and Event Items feature, it isn't available yet. However, we want to make sure you have information to make an informed decision about when to use Required Sessions. ::: ### The Takeaway * The Required Sessions feature makes it mandatory for an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} to register for a specific {{variable.Object_Session}} at an {{variable.Object_Event}}. * The Min/Max feature allows Event Organizers to set upper and/or lower limits on the number of {{variable.Object_Session}}s or Event Items an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can select when registering for an {{variable.Object_Event}}.
procedures: * If the capacities of the Event Items and Sessions are not manually configure
